name: Walnuts
description: Walnuts are a unique superfood rich in alpha-linolenic acid (Omega-3) and antioxidants. They are renowned for supporting brain health and cardiovascular function due to their high nutrient density.

macroNutrients.name: Calories
macroNutrients.description: High-energy food; recommended for consumption in moderate portions.

macroNutrients.name: Protein
macroNutrients.description: A good source of plant-based protein.

macroNutrients.name: Fats
macroNutrients.description: Primarily healthy polyunsaturated fatty acids, including Omega-3s.

macroNutrients.name: Carbohydrates
macroNutrients.description: Includes dietary fiber that supports digestive health.

microNutrients.name: Alpha-Linolenic Acid
microNutrients.description: An essential omega-3 fatty acid crucial for brain and cardiovascular health.

microNutrients.name: Fiber
microNutrients.description: Supports digestive health and helps maintain steady blood sugar levels.

microNutrients.name: Manganese
microNutrients.description: Provides powerful antioxidant defense and supports bone formation.

microNutrients.name: Copper
microNutrients.description: Supports iron metabolism, nerve health, and immune system function.

microNutrients.name: Magnesium
microNutrients.description: Essential for the nervous system, muscle function, and blood pressure regulation.

microNutrients.name: Phosphorus
microNutrients.description: Aids in energy production (ATP) and maintains strong bones and cell membranes.

microNutrients.name: Vitamin B6
microNutrients.description: Supports protein metabolism, cognitive development, and immune function.

microNutrients.name: Iron
microNutrients.description: Supports oxygen transport in the blood and cellular energy production.

microNutrients.name: Zinc
microNutrients.description: Crucial for DNA synthesis, immune defense, and wound healing.

microNutrients.name: Vitamin B9
microNutrients.description: Supports cell growth, red blood cell formation, and DNA synthesis.

microNutrients.name: Arginine
microNutrients.description: An amino acid that improves blood flow and vascular health through nitric oxide production.

microNutrients.name: Leucine
microNutrients.description: An essential amino acid that plays a vital role in muscle protein synthesis.

microNutrients.name: Valine
microNutrients.description: Supports tissue repair, muscle metabolism, and energy regulation.

healthBenefits: Brain Support: High levels of antioxidants and Omega-3s improve cognitive function.
Heart Health: Helps lower levels of 'bad' LDL cholesterol.
Inflammation Control: Contains compounds that reduce chronic inflammatory processes.
precautions: Caloric Density: Due to the high caloric density, portion control is recommended.
Allergy: Nuts are a common and severe allergen for many individuals.
Oxidation: The oils in nuts oxidize quickly; store in a cool, dark place to maintain quality.
